title: A Summit for the Compass
premise: Jude Marchetti, a disgraced mountain guide surviving on odd expeditions and a mounting debt to the wrong people, is hired to lead a wealthy salvage team to a cave the receding tide exposes once a decade. Inside, the team finds a wrecked expedition from the 1930s — and evidence that its leader faked his own death to disappear, leaving behind a compass identical to Jude's own. When the debt collectors arrive mid-expedition, Jude must choose between selling the discovery to clear their name or destroying the evidence to protect the descendants of the man who once saved their grandfather's life. The story ends with Jude guiding the team home in silence, compass in hand, choosing belonging over vindication as the sea swallows the cave again.
about_author: Jude Galloway spent seven seasons as a glacier guide in the North Cascades before a knee injury turned them into a writer of expeditions they can no longer lead. They live in a converted fishing cabin on Puget Sound, where the tide still dictates the schedule.

chapters.title: The Debt Collector's Weather
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Broke and blacklisted, Jude takes a last-chance contract from the Voss salvage family, then is cornered by the man holding their debt: deliver something valuable from the trip, or lose everything. Emotional beat: desperation dressed as professionalism, and the first glimpse that the Voss expedition is stranger than the contract admits.

chapters.title: Low Tide, High Stakes
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. The team — patriarch Elias Voss, his skeptical daughter Maren, a hungover geologist, and a photographer with secrets — reaches the coast where the tide is receding unnaturally far. Jude leads them across exposed seabed to a cave mouth that shouldn't exist. Emotional beat: wonder undercut by Jude's growing sense of being watched, and the compass needle spinning wildly.

chapters.title: What the Sea Kept
chapters.summary: Maren's POV. Inside the cave, the team discovers the intact camp of the 1934 Aldridge expedition — journals, ration tins, a frozen body none of them expected. Maren realizes her father has known about this site for years. Emotional beat: awe curdling into suspicion; Maren begins to see her father as a stranger.

chapters.title: The Second Compass
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. Among the artifacts, Jude finds a brass compass identical to their own — the one their grandfather left them — engraved with the same initials. The journals reveal Aldridge staged his death and vanished inland with a secret the others died protecting. Emotional beat: vertigo of identity; Jude's inheritance suddenly has a price tag on it, and Elias Voss knows it.

chapters.title: Terms of Silence
chapters.summary: Elias's POV. Elias reveals he funded the expedition to claim the site before a rival consortium, and offers to erase Jude's debt in exchange for the compass and their silence. Jude stalls. Emotional beat: the seduction of a clean slate, and the reader's first full view of Elias — a man who mistakes ownership for belonging.

chapters.title: The Turn
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. The tide returns early, trapping the team inside as the cave floods to its ceiling. One route out: the passage Aldridge's journal describes, through the flooded lower gallery. The geologist panics; the photographer confesses they were hired by the rival consortium. Emotional beat: survival stripped to essentials — trust becomes the only equipment that matters.

chapters.title: Through the Drowned Gallery
chapters.summary: Maren's POV. The team dives the flooded passage in relays, guided by Jude and the twin compasses, which seem to point not north but toward each other. The photographer nearly drowns; Maren saves them and chooses the team over her father's mission. Emotional beat: fear transfigured into loyalty; Maren's defection from Elias.

chapters.title: The Debt Comes Due
chapters.summary: Jude's POV. On the surface, the debt collector is waiting with the rival consortium — Elias sold Jude out as insurance. Elias is taken; the collector demands the compass and everything the team knows. Jude must decide in minutes what the discovery is worth. Emotional beat: betrayal as clarity — Jude finally sees exactly who they've been becoming.

chapters.title: What Jude Marchetti Carries
chapters.summary: Jude's POV, climax. Jude trades the compass — the one true link to their grandfather — to buy the team's freedom, then burns Aldridge's journals before the consortium can read them, keeping only the pages naming the descendants Aldridge abandoned and, perhaps, saved. Emotional beat: the price of survival paid in full, and the strange peace of paying it.

chapters.title: Homecoming Tide
chapters.summary: Jude's POV, resolution. Weeks later, Jude delivers the final journal pages anonymously to Aldridge's last living descendant, then joins Maren and the survivors for a quiet meal as the sea closes over the cave for another decade. The debt is gone; the name is still blacklisted; Jude stays anyway. Emotional beat: belonging chosen, not earned — and the compass's absence felt like a fullness rather than a loss.
